proposals.title: Add integration test for grade_thematic ensuring falsifier_evaluations.jsonl is produced, unblocking falsifier_honesty accrual
proposals.rationale: Sensor falsifier_honesty is stuck accruing because grade_thematic has never run (file absent). A test that validates the script's output under a controlled input ensures the data path is functional, allowing the sensor to begin accruing real data once the nightly job runs. This is a low-risk, high-leverage fix to unblock the sensor without altering signal paths.

notes: 1 proposal(s) after dedup/cap; 0 rejected. TIL fitness accrues until 2026-10-15 — contracts minted now are shadow/display-tier and grade only after their check_by. Nothing here is a runtime signal (R-AUT-1).
